records.source: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃
records.gloss: To a person [belong the] plans of [the] heart, but from YHWH [is the] answer of [the] tongue.
pieces: People make the plans in their minds, \q but the right answer comes from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.1: [The] plans of [the] heart belong to a person, \q but from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [comes the] answer of [the] tongue.

R.1: People can plan what they want to say. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} decides what they actually say.

decisions.choice: human plans and God's say: verses 1–9 on God's rule over human choices
decisions.reason: The chapter opens with a run of sayings on how the LORD governs what people plan and do (verses 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 33).

decisions.choice: the answer of the tongue: what is actually said
decisions.reason: People prepare; the outcome, even the words that come out, is the LORD's (verse 9; 19:21).

records.source: כָּֽל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
records.gloss: All [the] ways of a person [are] pure in his eyes, but YHWH weighs spirits.
pieces: People think all their ways are pure, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} weighs the motives.

L.2: All [the] ways of a person [are] pure in {{gender:their|his}} own eyes, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} weighs [the] spirits.

R.2: People always think they are doing right. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} knows why they really do things.

decisions.reason: Spirits (ruhot) are the inner person (21:2; 24:12). The picture is of weighing on scales, as in the Egyptian image of the heart weighed at death.

records.source: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
records.gloss: Roll to YHWH your works, and your plans will be established.
pieces: Hand over what you do to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and your plans will stand firm.

L.3: Roll your works onto {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and your plans will be established.

R.3: Trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with everything you do, \q and your plans will succeed.

decisions.reason: To roll something onto someone is to leave it with them (Psalm 22:9; 37:5).

records.source: כֹּ֤לפָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃
records.gloss: YHWH has made everything for its purpose, and even the wicked for [the] day of trouble.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made everything for its own end, \q even the wicked for the day of disaster.

L.4: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made everything for its purpose, \q even [the] wicked for [the] day of trouble.

R.4: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made everything for a reason. \q Even evil people will face a day of trouble.

decisions.choice: for its purpose: for its answer, its end
decisions.reason: The word (maaneh) is "answer" (verse 1): each thing fits God's purpose. It does not say God made people wicked, but that even the wicked do not escape his order: they meet their day of trouble.

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
records.gloss: An abomination of YHWH [is] every haughty of heart; hand to hand, he will not go unpunished.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests all the proud of heart; \q be sure of it, they will not escape punishment.

L.5: Everyone proud of heart [is] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q be sure, {{gender:they|he}} will not go unpunished.

R.5: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates proud people. \q You can be sure they will be punished.

decisions.reason: As in 11:21.

records.source: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
records.gloss: By loyalty and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by [the] fear of YHWH [one] turns from evil.
pieces: Loyal love and faithfulness make amends for wrong, \q and through the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} people turn away from evil.

L.6: By loyal love and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, \q and by [the] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [one] turns from evil.

R.6: Guilt is taken away by love and faithfulness. \q Honoring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe keeps people from doing evil.

decisions.choice: atoned for by loyal love and faithfulness
alternatives: a person's loyal love and faithfulness
decisions.reason: The verb (kipper) is the word for atonement by sacrifice. The loyal love may be God's, which covers sin, or the person's own, which shows true repentance (compare 10:12; Daniel 4:27). The saying does not set aside sacrifice but shows what God looks for (15:8).

records.source: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: When YHWH is pleased with [the] ways of a person, even his enemies he makes at peace with him.
pieces: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with how someone lives, \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes even their enemies make peace with them.

L.7: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with a person's ways, \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes even {{gender:their|his}} enemies to be at peace with {{gender:them|him}}.

R.7: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with the way people live, \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can make even their enemies become their friends.

decisions.choice: he makes peace: the LORD, or the person
decisions.reason: The subject of "makes at peace" is most likely the LORD.

records.source: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
records.gloss: Better [is] a little with righteousness than great gains without justice.
pieces: Better a little gained honestly \q than a fortune made by injustice.

L.8: Better [is] a little with righteousness \q than great income without justice.

R.8: It is better to have a little money that you got honestly \q than a lot that you got by cheating.

records.source: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: [The] heart of a person plans his way, but YHWH establishes his step.
pieces: People plot their course in their minds, \q but it is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who guides their steps.

L.9: A person's heart plans {{gender:their|his}} way, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} directs {{gender:their|his}} step.

R.9: People make plans for their lives. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} decides where they will go.

decisions.reason: Compare 19:21; 20:24; Jeremiah 10:23.

records.source: קֶ֤סֶם׀עַֽל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־פִּֽיו׃
records.gloss: Divination [is] on [the] lips of a king; in judgment his mouth will not be unfaithful.
pieces: A king's words are like an oracle; \q when he gives judgment, his mouth should not go wrong.

L.10: An oracle [is] on [the] lips of [the] king; \q in judgment his mouth will not betray [justice].

R.10: When a king makes a decision, it is as if God is speaking. \q So he must always be fair.

decisions.choice: an oracle: a decision with divine authority
decisions.reason: The word (qesem) usually means forbidden divination (Deuteronomy 18:10). Here it is used loosely: the king's verdict carries the weight of a divine word, so he must judge rightly.

decisions.choice: will not be unfaithful: or "must not be"
decisions.reason: The line may state the ideal or lay a duty on the king. Verses 10–15 are about kings.

records.source: פֶּ֤לֶס׀וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִֽיס׃
records.gloss: A balance and scales of justice [are] YHWH's; his work [are] all [the] weights of [the] bag.
pieces: Honest scales and balances belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q every weight in the bag is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} concern.

L.11: Honest balance and scales belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q all [the] weights in [the] bag [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work.

R.11: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} wants people to use honest scales. \q He cares about every weight they use.

decisions.reason: The merchant's weights were kept in a bag (Deuteronomy 25:13). Honest trade belongs to God's order.

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃
records.gloss: An abomination of kings [is] doing wickedness, for by righteousness a throne is established.
pieces: Kings detest wrongdoing, \q for a throne is made secure by righteousness.

L.12: Doing wickedness [is] an abomination to kings, \q for by righteousness a throne is established.

R.12: Good kings hate evil, \q because a king rules well when he does what is right.

decisions.choice: an abomination to kings: what a king should detest
alternatives: wickedness done by kings is an abomination
decisions.reason: It may mean kings should hate evil done by others, or that evil done by kings is detestable.

records.source: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
records.gloss: [The] delight of kings [are] lips of righteousness, and [one] speaking upright [things] he loves.
pieces: Kings take pleasure in honest speech; \q they value the one who speaks what is right.

L.13: Righteous lips [are the] delight of kings, \q and he loves one who speaks what is right.

R.13: Kings like people who are honest. \q They love people who speak the truth.

decisions.reason: The singular verb refers to each king.

records.source: חֲמַת־מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
records.gloss: [The] rage of a king [is] messengers of death, but a wise person will appease it.
pieces: A king's anger is a messenger of death, \q but a wise person will calm it.

L.14: [The] fury of a king [is like] messengers of death, \q but a wise person will appease it.

R.14: An angry king can have people killed. \q A wise person knows how to calm him down.

decisions.reason: The verb (kipper) is the one used of atonement in verse 6; here it means to pacify.

records.source: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
records.gloss: In [the] light of [the] face of a king [is] life, and his favor [is] like a cloud of spring rain.
pieces: When the king's face shines with favor, there is life, \q and his goodwill is like a rain cloud in spring.

L.15: In [the] light of [the] king's face [is] life, \q and his favor [is] like a cloud of [the] spring rain.

R.15: When a king is pleased with you, it is good for you. \q His kindness is like rain that makes crops grow.

decisions.choice: the spring rain: the last rain before harvest
decisions.reason: The latter rain (malqosh) in March–April filled out the grain before harvest (Deuteronomy 11:14). It was eagerly hoped for.

records.source: קְֽנֹה־חָכְמָ֗ה מַה־טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
records.gloss: To acquire wisdom, how much better than gold, and to acquire understanding is chosen more than silver.
pieces: How much better to gain wisdom than gold, \q to choose understanding rather than silver!

L.16: How much better [is it] to get wisdom than gold, \q and to get understanding [is] to be chosen rather than silver.

R.16: It is much better to become wise than to get gold. \q It is better to understand than to have silver.

decisions.choice: better than gold: as in 3:14 and 8:10, 19

records.source: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: [The] highway of upright [people] [is] to turn from evil; [one] keeping his way guards his life.
pieces: The highway of the upright avoids evil; \q whoever watches their step protects their life.

L.17: [The] highway of [the] upright [is] to turn from evil; \q whoever watches {{gender:their|his}} way guards {{gender:their|his}} life.

R.17: Good people stay away from evil, like travelers keeping to a safe road. \q If you are careful how you live, you will stay safe.

decisions.reason: The word (mesillah) of 15:19's "built up".

records.source: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
records.gloss: Before breaking [is] pride, and before stumbling [is] haughtiness of spirit.
pieces: Pride comes first, then the crash; \q a haughty spirit, then the fall.

L.18: Before a crash [comes] pride, \q and before stumbling [comes] a haughty spirit.

R.18: Proud people will soon be ruined. \q People who think they are better than others will soon fall.

decisions.reason: The word (shever) means a breaking or collapse (15:4; 17:19).

records.source: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ר֭וּחַ אֶת־עֲנָוִ֑ים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־גֵּאִֽים׃
records.gloss: Better [is] lowliness of spirit with [the] humble than dividing plunder with [the] proud.
pieces: Better to be humble and live among the lowly \q than to share the spoils with the proud.

L.19: Better [to be] lowly in spirit with [the] humble \q than to divide plunder with [the] proud.

R.19: It is better to be humble and poor \q than to share stolen goods with proud people.

decisions.choice: the humble, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: As in 3:34 and 14:21.

records.source: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
records.gloss: [One] attending to a word will find good, and [one] trusting in YHWH, how blessed [is] he.
pieces: Whoever heeds instruction will prosper, \q and how blessed is the one who trusts in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

L.20: Whoever pays attention to [the] word will find good, \q and whoever trusts in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, how blessed [is] {{gender:that one|he}}.

R.20: If you listen to good teaching, things will go well for you. \q People who trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} are truly happy.

decisions.choice: the word: instruction, or a matter
decisions.reason: "Gives attention to a word" may mean heeding teaching or handling a matter wisely.

records.source: לַחֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
records.gloss: [The] wise of heart is called discerning, and sweetness of lips increases persuasiveness.
pieces: The wise in heart are known for their discernment, \q and pleasant words make teaching more persuasive.

L.21: [The] wise in heart is called discerning, \q and sweetness of lips increases persuasion.

R.21: People who are wise are known for their understanding. \q Kind words help others learn.

decisions.reason: The word of 1:5 and 7:21. Here good teaching gains from a pleasant manner.

records.source: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
records.gloss: A fountain of life [is] insight [to] its owners, but [the] discipline of fools [is] folly.
pieces: Good sense is a spring of life to those who have it, \q but folly is the punishment of fools.

L.22: Insight [is] a fountain of life to those who have it, \q but [the] discipline of fools [is] folly.

R.22: Good sense gives life to the people who have it. \q But foolish people are punished by their own foolishness.

decisions.choice: the discipline of fools is folly: folly punishes itself
decisions.reason: Most likely fools are disciplined by their own folly; or, it is folly to try to instruct fools.

records.source: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
records.gloss: [The] heart of a wise [person] makes his mouth prudent, and to his lips adds persuasiveness.
pieces: A wise heart guides the mouth \q and makes the lips more persuasive.

L.23: [The] heart of [the] wise makes {{gender:their|his}} mouth prudent \q and adds persuasion to {{gender:their|his}} lips.

R.23: Wise people think before they speak. \q That makes others more willing to listen.

decisions.reason: See verse 21.

records.source: צוּף־דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
records.gloss: A honeycomb of honey [are] words of kindness, sweet to [the] soul and healing to [the] bones.
pieces: Kind words are a honeycomb, \q sweet to taste and health for the body.

L.24: Kind words [are] a honeycomb, \q sweet to [the] soul and healing to [the] bones.

R.24: Kind words are like honey. \q They make you feel good and help you be healthy.

decisions.reason: Honey was the sweetest food and also gave strength (1 Samuel 14:27).

records.source: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃
records.gloss: There is a way right before a person, but its end [is the] ways of death.
pieces: There is a road that seems right to a person, \q but where it ends is death.

L.25: There is a way [that seems] right to a person, \q but its end [is the] way to death.

R.25: Some ways of living seem right to people, \q but they lead to death.

records.source: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃
records.gloss: [The] appetite of a laborer labors for him, for his mouth presses on him.
pieces: A worker's hunger works for him; \q his mouth drives him on.

L.26: [The] appetite of [the] worker works for {{gender:them|him}}, \q for {{gender:their|his}} mouth urges {{gender:them|him}} on.

R.26: Hungry people work hard because they need food.

decisions.reason: The word of 6:30 and 10:3. Hunger is a good motive for work (Ecclesiastes 6:7).

records.source: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָת֗וֹ כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
records.gloss: A man of worthlessness digs up evil, and on his lip [is] like a scorching fire.
pieces: A scoundrel digs up trouble, \q and their talk is like a scorching fire.

L.27: A worthless person digs up evil, \q and on {{gender:their|his}} lips [it is] like a scorching fire.

R.27: Worthless people look for ways to cause trouble. \q Their words burn like fire.

decisions.reason: See 6:12; James 3:6.

decisions.choice: digs up evil: prepares harm, like a pit
decisions.reason: Digging a pit to trap someone (26:27; Psalm 7:16).

records.source: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ןמַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
records.gloss: A man of perversities spreads strife, and a slanderer separates a close friend.
pieces: A twisted person stirs up conflict, \q and a gossip separates close friends.

L.28: A perverse person spreads strife, \q and a gossip separates close friends.

R.28: Dishonest people cause fights. \q Gossips can make even best friends turn against each other.

decisions.reason: The word (nirgan) is one who whispers tales (18:8; 26:20, 22).

records.source: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־טֽוֹב׃
records.gloss: A man of violence entices his neighbor and leads him in a way not good.
pieces: A violent person lures a neighbor \q and leads them down a bad road.

L.29: A violent person entices {{gender:their|his}} neighbor \q and leads {{gender:them|him}} in a way that is not good.

R.29: Violent people trick their neighbors into doing wrong.

decisions.reason: The gang of 1:10–19 did just this.

records.source: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
records.gloss: [One] shutting his eyes to devise perverse things, [one] pursing his lips, completes evil.
pieces: Someone who winks is plotting something twisted; \q someone who purses the lips has already done harm.

L.30: One who shuts {{gender:their|his}} eyes [does it] to plot perversity; \q one who purses {{gender:their|his}} lips has [already] done evil.

R.30: Watch out for people who wink or make faces at others. \q They are planning to do something evil.

decisions.choice: shutting the eyes, pursing the lips: signals

records.source: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃
records.gloss: A crown of glory [is] gray hair; in [the] way of righteousness it is found.
pieces: Gray hair is a glorious crown, \q won by living a righteous life.

L.31: Gray hair [is] a crown of glory; \q it is found in [the] way of righteousness.

R.31: Gray hair is like a beautiful crown. \q People get it by living a long and good life.

decisions.reason: A long life is linked with righteousness (3:2; 10:27). Gray hair is honored (20:29).

records.source: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
records.gloss: Better [is one] long of anger than a warrior, and [one] ruling over his spirit than [one] capturing a city.
pieces: Patience is worth more than a warrior's strength, \q and self-control more than conquering a city.

L.32: Better [is one] slow to anger than a warrior, \q and one who rules {{gender:their|his}} spirit than one who captures a city.

R.32: It is better to be patient than to be a great soldier. \q It is better to control your temper than to capture a city.

decisions.choice: better than a warrior: inner strength is greater

records.source: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: Into the lap the lot is thrown, but from YHWH [is] every decision of it.
pieces: The lot is tossed into the lap, \q but how it falls is decided by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.33: Into the lap the lot is cast, \q but every decision of it [is] from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

R.33: People throw lots to decide things. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who decides how the lots fall.

decisions.choice: the lot: stones or sticks used to make decisions
decisions.reason: Lots were cast to settle questions and divide land, trusting God to decide (Joshua 18:6; Acts 1:26).

decisions.choice: every decision is from the LORD: nothing is chance
decisions.reason: The chapter ends as it began: the LORD rules even what seems random (verses 1, 9).
